    n &= 7
    return ((v << n) | (v >> (8 - n))) & 0xFF if n else v & 0xFF

pw = ''.join(chr(sol[k][0]) for k in range(16))

# verify all groups exactly one printable candidate
print("unique:", all(len(v)==1 for v in sol.values()))
